a: €1,000 cash prize per IAU Division (from 2026, with the Shaw Prize Foundation); winners are invited to present at the 2027 General Assembly with registration covered
dt: 2026 round extended to Jan 15, 2027 (normally Dec 15); theses defended Dec 16, 2025 to Dec 15, 2026
e: Annual prize, now called the IAU-Shaw PhD Prize, for the most remarkable PhD thesis in each IAU Division's area (including high-energy phenomena and fundamental physics), plus a PhD Prize at Large. Open to candidates from any country; candidates apply directly, no nomination needed.
unv: Time of day for the extended Jan 15, 2027 deadline not stated
